profile.headline: Senior Fullstack Software Engineer
profile.summary: A Senior Full-Stack Software Engineer with over +10 years of technical experience in various roles and industries, including scientific research, public health, banking, and fintech. I am driven by the opportunity to use technology to solve complex problems that contribute to enabling others' health, finances, or overall well-being. I find that projects which actively address and solve issues affecting others are the most rewarding. These opportunities not only challenge me technically but also allow me to make a meaningful impact, helping me grow the most as an engineer.

positions.title: Senior Fullstack Software Engineer
positions.description: Senior Fullstack Software Engineer on the Apply team. Enabling America to register for Medicare and Medicaid.

positions.title: Fullstack Software Engineer III
positions.locationName: Oak Ridge, Tennessee, United States · Remote
positions.description: Fullstack Software Engineer III in the Data Lifecycle and Scalable Workflows Group, as well as in the Data and Platforms Solutions service. Services led follow FAIR Guiding Principles for scientific data management and stewardship, aiming to improve research productivity and scientific reproducibility.
positions.insights: Skills: Javascript · Rust (Programming Language) · Go (Programming Language) · High Performance Computing (HPC) · Ruby · C++ · Gitlab · ArangoDB · Python · OpenShift · OpenStack · Kubernetes · Rancher Kubernetes Management · Quantum Computing · ZeroMQ · Research Skills

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Full-Stack developer on the Growth and Experience team
positions.insights: Skills: React.js · TypeScript · Ruby · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · GraphQL · REST APIs · Terraform · PostgreSQL · Amazon Dynamodb · Amazon Relational Database Service (RDS)

positions.title: Senior Information Technology Analyst
positions.description:
Led a cross-functional team of 15 in 3 locations (San Antonio, Guadalajara and India) from 9pm-6am CST with a 25% increase in first contact resolution, average handling time, and high customer satisfaction rates. This team was comprised of mid to senior-level engineers who oversaw service desk operations, maintenance, data analysis, and business development.
Managed production servers using Splunk and performed maintenance and job scheduling with offshore team coordination.
Triaged USAA staff and offshore teams from general Office applications to one of over 3,000+ proprietary programs.

positions.title: Junior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Created, managed, and pruned critical member-facing features within the Policy Administration and Policy Claims system utilizing Java with Spring Boot.
Delivered policy renewal comparison resolution for API timeout using migration to a new service, reducing stall by 30 seconds, allowing for a 2-second load with Node.js, Express.js, MongoDB, AWS Cloudformation and Terrraform.
Spearheaded the development of a RESTful API in Go with AWS DynamoDB
Support offshore team with PnC Java wicket tools development. sing AIR practices to update member facing and MSR facing applications.

positions.title: IT Support Specialist
positions.description: Triage internal USAA staff with onsite and offsite troubleshooting ranging from general application issues to over one of 3000+ proprietary programs. Members range from contracted staffing to long time employees of USAA with specialty in fields such as banking, development, claims, and finances. Remote team support over 30,000+ employees on daily basis to custom solutions for smooth internal operations.

positions.title: .NET Software Engineer
positions.description:
Engineered custom mortgage reports using .NET and VBA within The Mortgage Office’s Active Report 11 designer.
Extracted, transferred, and loaded (ETL) client data to reduce worktime from 3 hours to 30 seconds.
Receive mortgage apprenticeship for standard operation protocol between renters and owners.

positions.title: Field Technician
positions.description:
Expertly diagnosed and resolved hardware and software issues for over 500 clients across desktops, laptops, tablets, and smartphones.
Spearheaded the development and implementation of innovative 3D printing solutions for hardware replacements, reducing wait time by 30% for clients traditionally waiting for parts to ship in.
Leveraged ReactJS to revamp user interfaces, boosting user satisfaction by 25%, and the Sequelize ORM, which streamlined the backend processes, leading to a 15% increase in operational efficiency.

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
Oversee full development of website from start to finish. Stack included PHP Laravel October CMS via Digital Ocean server for easy management of services. All of these services were then micromanaged by Forgre Laravel for monitoring and health as dev ops operations to ensure smoothing running. 
TexasRL was a grassroots effort to reach out to the Texas Rocket League and surrounding state communities, successfully hosting multiple events, many being the first of their kind.

positions.title: Solutions Consultant
positions.description: Oversee development of front & backend through full lifecycle. Utilities include PHP Laravel framework with CMS functionality for easy to use modification. jQuery, Modernizr, Moment.js, Select2, SweetAlert, and the Mustache framework were implemented through the backend for plugin building, active alerts, and ease of use. Streamline entire process through Digital Ocean servers for cost effective solution.

projects.title: DataFed
projects.description: DataFed is a federated scientific data system enabling cross-facility research like experimentation, simulation, and analytics. It offers infrastructure to build a flexible data network across dispersed facilities. Within this network, data access remains straightforward and consistent, no matter the storage location, environment, or security policies.

organizations.name: Esports Stadium Arlington
organizations.position: San Antonio Community Ambassador · Mar 2019 - Oct 2022
organizations.description: Bring operations and a community/grass roots effort to the large metropolitan cities of Texas including San Antonio, Austin, Houston, and Dallas. Oversee involvement in esports and the localization of gaming to both youth and growing audiences through performance and dialogue by talent and members of the community.
